title: Final Wave Function
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct wave function after photon emission.

title: Probability Expression
description: Important Criteria: The student should derive the expression for the relative probability P_1/P_0 correctly.

title: Numerical Estimate
description: Essential Criteria: The student must calculate the numerical value of P_1/P_0 accurately using the given parameters.

title: Use of Operators
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly apply creation and annihilation operators in their derivation.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check that all units are consistent throughout their calculations.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common errors such as sign mistakes or incorrect factors in their calculations.
